programs.name: Destination Thailand Visa (DTV)
programs.tax: Territorial — foreign income generally untaxed if remitted rules met
programs.note: Renewal terms not yet fully established since 2024 launch — most flexible entry point in the region right now.

programs.name: DE Rantau Nomad Pass
programs.tax: Non-resident territorial system for short stays
programs.note: Most predictable paperwork in the region — but 'tech work' is interpreted narrowly, generalist freelancers sometimes declined.

programs.name: Second Home Visa (Bali route)
programs.tax: Complex — consult a local tax advisor before staying past 183 days
programs.note: High capital bar but by far the longest runway. A separate lower-threshold E33G remote-worker route ($60k/yr income) also exists but rollout has been inconsistent.

programs.name: Digital Nomad Visa
programs.tax: Short-stay, generally outside local tax residency
programs.note: Best for a high-earning short cultural stint, not a long-term base — you'll need to leave and can't simply extend.

programs.name: 90-day e-visa (workaround)
programs.tax: Undefined for remote workers — legal gray area
programs.note: No dedicated nomad visa exists. Widely used anyway, but you're technically on a tourist visa while working — treat as short-term only.

programs.name: Tourist extension / SRRV route
programs.note: A dedicated digital nomad visa is reportedly in development — worth checking current status before committing long-term plans here.
